RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
Adhere to typography hierarchy: titles 10-12pt bold, labels 8-9pt, notes 7-8pt.
Adhere to stroke hierarchy: containers 1.5pt, dividers 1.0pt, arrows 1.5pt.
Icons are monochrome thin grey line art. No colored icons.
Amber (#E69F00) is used for borders and hatching ONLY, never for text.
Each of the three outcome boxes must be distinguishable in GREYSCALE by border style: solid medium, solid with hatch, dashed.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning decorative symbols, NO 3D rendering.
Flat vector style: no gradients, no drop shadows, no photographic imagery.
The bottom scope bar carries NO chromatic colour and NO risk-level shading.
